privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: GitPrice is a browser extension that helps you compare prices across supported online stores. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and your rights as a user.

section1.heading: 1. Information We Collect
section1.p1: GitPrice collects the minimum data necessary to provide price comparison functionality.
section1.p2: Data collected automatically while using the extension:
section1.li3: •  Product identifiers (ASIN, SKU) and product titles from the pages you browse on supported stores
section1.li4: •  Current prices displayed on those pages
section1.li5: •  Your extension settings stored in chrome.storage.sync
section1.li6: •  Anonymous error and crash reports (opt-out available in Settings → Privacy)
section1.li8: •  Email address used to create your GitPrice account
section1.li9: •  Authentication tokens stored locally in chrome.storage.local
section1.p10: We do not collect your browsing history outside supported store pages, financial information, passwords, or any personally identifiable information beyond your email if you register.

section2.heading: 2. How We Use Your Information
section2.li1: •  To search for and display competing prices across supported stores
section2.li2: •  To send price-drop notifications for products you are tracking (if enabled)
section2.li3: •  To improve extension reliability by diagnosing crashes and errors
section2.li4: •  To authenticate your account and manage Pro subscription status
section2.p5: We do not use your data for advertising, profiling, or sale to third parties.

section3.heading: 3. Third-Party Services and Affiliate Links
section3.p1: GitPrice may redirect you to supported stores using affiliate links. These links allow us to earn a small commission when you make a purchase, at no additional cost to you.
section3.p2: When you follow an affiliate link, the destination store’s own privacy policy applies. GitPrice does not share your personal information with affiliate stores.
section3.p3: We use a small number of service providers to run this website. Vercel hosts the site and processes standard request data (such as IP address and browser type) to deliver it. If you join the waitlist, our own form collects your email address and stores it on GitPrice’s servers. We use it only to send you the launch email, and we remove it on request.

section4.heading: 4. Data Storage and Security
section4.p1: Your extension settings and authentication tokens are stored locally in your browser using Chrome’s secure storage APIs (chrome.storage.local and chrome.storage.sync). Server-side data is stored on secured servers with access controls and encryption at rest.
section4.p2: We retain price comparison data only as long as necessary. Account data is retained until you delete your account.

section5.heading: 5. Data Sharing
section5.p1: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information. We may share data only in these limited circumstances:
section5.li2: •  Service providers: Third-party vendors assisting in operating the extension under strict confidentiality agreements
section5.li3: •  Legal requirements: If required by applicable law, court order, or governmental authority
section5.li4: •  Business transfers: In connection with a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, with notice to users

section6.heading: 6. Your Rights
section6.p1: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the right to:
section6.li2: •  Access: Request a copy of the personal data we hold about you
section6.li3: •  Correction: Ask us to correct inaccurate data
section6.li4: •  Deletion: Request deletion of your account and associated data
section6.li5: •  Portability: Receive your data in a machine-readable format
section6.li6: •  Objection: Object to processing based on legitimate interests
section6.li7: •  Opt-out of error reporting: Disable anonymous error reports in Settings → Privacy
section6.p8: To exercise these rights, contact us at privacy@gitprice.com.

section7.heading: 7. Cookies and Tracking
section7.p1: The GitPrice extension itself does not set cookies. When you visit store pages, those sites may set their own cookies — their respective privacy policies govern that activity.
section7.p2: This website uses Vercel Analytics to count page views. It does not set cookies or identify individual visitors.
section7.p3: With your consent, this website also uses Heap Analytics to understand how visitors use it (pages viewed, clicks, and general device and browser information). Heap sets its own cookies only after you accept them in the cookie notice, and you can change your choice at any time from the link in the site footer. We do not use this data for advertising.
section7.p4: This website also uses Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics to measure visits and where they come from. Until you make a choice in the cookie notice, Google Analytics runs without cookies and receives only anonymous signals. If you allow cookies, Google Analytics sets its own cookies to recognise returning visits; if you decline, it sets none. We do not use this data for advertising.

section8.heading: 8. Children’s Privacy
section8.p1: GitPrice is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has provided us with personal data, contact us at privacy@gitprice.com and we will promptly delete it.

section9.heading: 9. Changes to This Policy
section9.p1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will post the revised policy on this page with an updated effective date. For significant changes, we will notify you via a notice in the extension.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: Please read these Terms of Service carefully before installing or using the GitPrice Chrome extension. By installing or using the Service, you agree to be bound by these Terms. If you do not agree, do not install or use the Service.

section1.heading: 1. Description of Service
section1.p1: GitPrice is a browser extension that automatically detects product pages on supported online stores and displays price comparisons for the same or equivalent products across those stores. The Service also provides optional price-drop alerts and a 6-month local price history for tracked products.
section1.p2: GitPrice is a pre-launch MVP product offered free of charge during its initial release. The scope of supported stores and features may change over time.

section2.heading: 2. Eligibility and Account
section2.p1: You must be at least 13 years of age to use the Service. You may use GitPrice without creating an account. Certain features (such as syncing alerts across devices) require registration. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials.

section3.heading: 3. User Obligations
section3.p1: By using the Service, you agree to:
section3.li2: •  Use the Service only for personal, non-commercial price-comparison purposes.
section3.li3: •  Not attempt to reverse-engineer, decompile, or scrape the Service itself.
section3.li4: •  Not use the Service to automate bulk purchases, generate fraudulent affiliate clicks, or circumvent the terms of any supported store.
section3.li5: •  Not interfere with or disrupt the Service’s infrastructure or the servers of third-party stores it accesses.
section3.li6: •  Comply with all applicable laws and regulations in your jurisdiction.

section4.heading: 4. Affiliate Disclosure
section4.p1: GitPrice participates in affiliate programmes operated by supported stores. When you click a price-comparison result or a “Go to Store” link provided by the Service, that link may contain an affiliate tracking code. If you complete a purchase after following such a link, GitPrice may receive a commission from the retailer at no additional cost to you. Affiliate commissions do not influence the prices displayed or the ranking of results — GitPrice always shows you the best available price regardless of affiliate relationships.

section5.heading: 5. Privacy and Data
section5.p1: GitPrice stores product data and price history locally on your device. No personal shopping data is transmitted to GitPrice servers in the current MVP release. For details on what data is collected and how it is used, please see our Privacy Policy.

section6.heading: 6. Disclaimer of Warranties
section6.p1: THE SERVICE IS PROVIDED “AS IS” AND “AS AVAILABLE” WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY KIND, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY, FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE, AND NON-INFRINGEMENT. GITPRICE DOES NOT WARRANT THAT PRICES DISPLAYED ARE ACCURATE, COMPLETE, OR UP TO DATE. PRICES ON THIRD-PARTY STORES MAY CHANGE AT ANY TIME, AND GITPRICE IS NOT RESPONSIBLE FOR DISCREPANCIES BETWEEN DISPLAYED AND ACTUAL PRICES.

section7.heading: 7. Limitation of Liability
section7.p1: TO THE MAXIMUM EXTENT PERMITTED BY APPLICABLE LAW, GITPRICE AND ITS OFFICERS, EMPLOYEES, AND CONTRIBUTORS SHALL NOT BE LIABLE FOR ANY INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, SPECIAL, CONSEQUENTIAL, OR PUNITIVE DAMAGES — INCLUDING LOSS OF PROFITS, DATA, OR GOODWILL — ARISING FROM YOUR USE OF OR INABILITY TO USE THE SERVICE, EVEN IF ADVISED OF THE POSSIBILITY OF SUCH DAMAGES. GITPRICE’S TOTAL LIABILITY TO YOU FOR ANY CLAIMS ARISING UNDER THESE TERMS SHALL NOT EXCEED USD 10.

section8.heading: 8. Third-Party Platforms
section8.p1: The Service accesses publicly available data on third-party online stores. GitPrice is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any retailer. Each store’s own terms of service govern your use of that store, and GitPrice makes no representations regarding those terms.

section9.heading: 9. Modifications to the Service and Terms
section9.p1: GitPrice reserves the right to modify or discontinue the Service at any time without notice. We may also update these Terms from time to time. We will indicate the date of the last revision at the top of this page. Your continued use of the Service after a change in Terms constitutes your acceptance of the revised Terms.

section10.heading: 10. Termination
section10.p1: You may stop using the Service at any time by uninstalling the extension. GitPrice may suspend or terminate your access to the Service if you violate these Terms. Upon termination, the obligations and limitations set forth in Sections 4–7 and 11 survive.

section11.heading: 11. Governing Law
section11.p1: These Terms are governed by the laws of the jurisdiction in which GitPrice is established, without regard to its conflict-of-law principles. Any dispute arising out of or relating to these Terms or the Service shall be subject to the competent courts of that jurisdiction, unless mandatory law where you live gives you the right to bring proceedings elsewhere.
